reading.rtitle: Email from Mike -- Tips for Your First Ad
paras: Hi Karina, thank you for your first ad. It is a good start! Here are my five tips. First, make it short. A good ad on Instagram has only three or four lines. People read fast on the phone.

Second, start with a verb: Discover, Watch, Visit. Don't start with We have. Third, talk to your customer, not about your company. Fourth, give one clear action: Click the link, or Send us a message. Only one action, please.
Fifth, don't put prices in the ad. Invite customers to talk to you. And finish with your slogan. Your customers remember a short slogan. Send me the new version on Friday. Best regards, Mike.
reading.source: Mike, social media consultant -- email to Karina, A1 reading

Watch the video now.

listenings.text: Are you ready to fly? Come to the Sao Paulo Business Aviation Fair, from May tenth to May twelfth. Discover more than forty new aircraft. Meet the best companies in the world. Visit our booth, number twelve, and talk to our team. Please book your ticket online today. Students and new customers have a special price. Don't miss the biggest aviation event of the year. Click the link and see you at the fair!

Hi, I am Sofia, from Texas. Last week I made my first video ad, and I want to share three tips with you. First, make it short. My ad is only thirty seconds. Second, start with a strong verb, like Discover or Imagine. Third, always end with one clear action. My ad ends with: Send us a message today. After one week, twenty new customers sent me a message. So, don't wait. Make your first ad this week!

extra_audio.text: First, Karina writes her first ad in English. Then, Mike reads the ad and sends her five tips. Next, Karina starts every line with a verb. After that, she adds her slogan: Fly with confidence. Finally, she launches the ad on Monday.
